title: Build the glass atrium and keep its interior perfectly clean
goal: Reproduce the sealed 82-block Glass Atrium (stone floor, hollow glass shell, empty 3x3x2 interior) on a fresh judged server, and pass on view_hit_rate, the judger's five-direction occlusion metric. Scaffolding or stray blocks left inside the bounding box occlude the expected surfaces and hold view_hit_rate below 1.0 even when every blueprint block is correct, so the plan must include a cleanup phase and the verify loop must compare both metrics to localize strays. Iterate build, scan, cleanup and re-verify until the judger records view_hit_rate 1.0.
resources: docker image itzg/minecraft-server:2024.6.1-java17 (Minecraft 1.19.2 vanilla; compose file assets/gc-365/docker-compose.yml)
docker image node:20.15.1 (Node 20 runtime for mineflayer bots and the judger's JS bridge)
process_expectations: The plan artifact includes an explicit scaffold budget and a cleanup phase with a sweep order over the interior volume
Both block_hit_rate and view_hit_rate snapshot series are recorded, and every divergence between them triggers a logged stray-block search
Stray/occluding blocks are tracked by identity (coordinate + block id) when found and shown removed in a later snapshot
The final verify pass (both metrics at 1.0 in data/score.json) ran before the server was torn down, and the teardown is in the run log
